answer: Each identity announces one distinct inlet prefix and locks a 70-credit crystal bond. It must stay announced through the horizon window; auditors recheck the routing table each epoch, and a withdrawn or shared prefix burns the bond. One prefix serves one identity, so each fake needs a new one: leasing costs 40 an epoch with no bulk discount, so 1000 fakes lock 70,000 and pay 40,000 per epoch. A rented-prefix farm fails: prefixes sharing one upstream network are clustered during the horizon window and their bonds burn. An honest agent announces once and keeps its bond after a clean epoch.
